purpose.zh: 活动踝关节，促进小腿放松
purpose.en: Move your ankle and loosen up your lower legs.

text.zh: 髋和膝不动，脚尖慢慢勾起再绷直
text.en: Keep your hip and knee still, pull your toes up, then point them

text.zh: 单手轻扶椅子，一只脚悬空
text.en: Rest one hand lightly on a chair and lift one foot off the floor.

text.zh: 动作缓慢有节奏，保持呼吸
text.en: Move slowly and steadily and keep breathing.

commonErrors.zh: 动作太快，整条腿跟着晃
commonErrors.en: Moving fast so the whole leg swings.

cautions.zh: 扶稳无轮的椅子，疼痛或站不稳时就停止
cautions.en: Hold a stable chair without wheels, and stop if it hurts or you feel unsteady.
